data.title: 间桐樱 · 弓道场·夕阳引弓与凛然英姿
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 弓道场·夕阳引弓与凛然英姿】夕阳金光穿透弓道场的木格拉门，换上整洁弓道服的樱挺拔站立，神情肃穆而专注地拉开长弓。利箭破空正中靶心的瞬间，她放下长弓转头看向你，眼神由凛然化作娇羞——「今天学长来看我练习……所以我才能射出这么满意的一箭呢。」
data.promptProse: After the shot, Sakura lowers her long Japanese bow beside her left leg and turns with a shy smile, right gloved hand relaxed and no new arrow drawn. Her white kyudo gi and indigo hakama fall over a stable stance. The full-body view follows wooden floorboards toward a distant target. Sunset enters the dojo's open side, illuminating the bow curve and jacket, casting long soft shadows across the practice floor.
data.action: 射箭结束后放低长弓，站稳回首，表情由专注转为羞涩微笑
data.lighting: warm sunset entering the open side of the dojo
data.camera: full-body shot, lowered longbow and stable stance visible
